pages.text: Grenadier!$(br2)When either hand slot holds a throwable brew, the doll can hear the order and throw the bottle. Brewing works exactly as it does for a player, and only throwable kinds are accepted.

Range$(br2)About 16 blocks — the shortest reach of anything a doll throws. Any further and the order is simply ignored.$(br2)Mind your allies$(br2)A lane blocked by a friendly is sidestepped first, and the bottle flies anyway after about a second of dodging.
